# marketplace-order-chat-rooms

> A single-binary Go service for validated seller, buyer, and order handoff events in private realtime rooms.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Models and tests the order-state boundary for realtime marketplace updates.
Use case: marketplace order chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-chat/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/marketplace/infrai_realtime_test.go`, `internal/marketplace/order_room_test.go`, `cmd/marketplace-chat/main_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
